items.source:
After the domain type has been specified, related projections or instances of the
domain type can be saved.
items.translation: 指定域类型后，可以保存相关的投影或该域类型的实例。

items.source: T - the type of the instance passed to this method. It should be the same as the domain type before or a projection of the domain type. If they are not related, the results may be undefined.
items.translation: T - 传递给此方法的实例类型。它应与域类型相同，或是域类型的投影。如果两者之间没有关联，则结果可能未定义。

items.source: T - the type of the instances passed to this method. It should be the same as the domain type before or a projection of the domain type. If they are not related, the results may be undefined.
items.translation: T - 传递给此方法的实例类型。它应与域类型相同，或是域类型的投影。如果两者之间没有关联，则结果可能未定义。

items.source:
the saved instance, can also be a new object, so you are recommended to
use this instance after the save operation
items.translation: 已保存的实例也可以是一个新对象，因此建议在保存操作后使用该实例。

items.source:
the saved instances, can also be a new objects, so you are recommended
to use those instances after the save operation
items.translation: 已保存的实例也可以是新对象，因此建议在保存操作后使用这些实例。
